page.title: Account
page.subtitle: Manage your password, data export, and account deletion

password.title: Change password
password.description: Enter your current password and choose a new password.
password.googleNoticeBody: You sign in with Google and do not have a local password set for this account, so changing a local password is not available.

export.title: Data export
export.description: Download a single JSON file with your profile, shopping lists, history, favorites, and products you created. Other users' data, password hashes, and tokens are never included.
export.success: Your data export has been downloaded.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Your account and all personal data (lists, history, favorites, and private products) will be permanently deleted.
delete.passwordPrompt: Enter your current password to confirm.
delete.deletedBody: Your account and associated data have been deleted. Your session has ended.
